brief.headline: Nvidia Rally Boosts Global Cues; Tata Steel Buys APL Apollo Stake
brief.summary: Indian equities face mixed cues after Nifty 50 dropped 1.75% while US markets surged overnight following the reinstatement of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Domestic sentiment remains cautious amid rate hike concerns after S&P trimmed India's FY28 GDP growth forecast to 7%. Meanwhile, corporate activity is highlighted by Tata Steel acquiring shares in APL Apollo Tubes.

takeaways.text: Tata Steel acquired 2,77,38,075 shares of APL Apollo Tubes for Rs 5,825 crore in a block deal, while aiming to maintain Rs 15,000 per tonne Ebitda.
S&P cut India FY28 GDP growth forecast to 7% and warned of a potential 25 bps RBI rate hike in December.
L&T bagged a Rs 5,000 crore order to deploy an AI cluster using NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Chennai.
US markets surged overnight as Nvidia stock skyrocketed after Jensen Huang was reinstated as CEO.
CrowdStrike agreed to acquire Zscaler in an all-stock deal valued at $44bn as cyber threats escalate.
Amazon acquired Decart's AI optimization technology for $7.5 billion to support its Trainium chips.

sections.india: Domestic markets snapped two days of gains as Nifty 50 slipped 1.75% and Bank Nifty plunged 3.17%. S&P revised India FY28 GDP forecast to 7% while warning of a possible 25 bps rate hike by RBI in December. In corporate developments, Tata Steel acquired 2,77,38,075 shares of APL Apollo Tubes worth Rs 5,825 crore in a block deal. Additionally, Dalmia Bharat approved a share buyback of up to 3.783 million shares for ₹700 crore.
sections.world: US equities logged sharp gains overnight after Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO. S&P 500 rose 4.66% while Nasdaq surged 6.31% as tech stocks rallied globally. Meanwhile, Brent crude fell 6.55% to 86.51 and Gold rose 3.63% to 3643.1.
sections.tech: Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO following a unanimous board vote and intervention by US officials. In major deals, CrowdStrike announced a $44bn acquisition of Zscaler, while Amazon acquired Decart's AI technology for $7.5 billion. L&T secured a Rs 5,000 crore order to deploy an AI cluster with NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Chennai.

The seed round, valuing the company at $1.15 billion, was led by venture firm Accel. Co-founder and CEO Dan Lewis joins Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)
stories.ai_summary: AI startup Marlowe reached a $1.15B valuation after raising $277 million to develop non-Nvidia processors.
stories.why_it_matters: Points to rising venture capital funding for alternative compute architecture startups.

stories.title: Anthropic Rolls Out Zero Data Retention Policy for Advanced AI
stories.summary: Anthropic PBC is releasing a new safety system that lets business customers keep control of their data when using its most capable artificial intelligence models — a stark change from an earlier data-retention policy the company had announced to mitigate potential cyberattacks.
stories.ai_summary: Anthropic introduced a zero data retention safety policy allowing business clients full control over AI data.
stories.why_it_matters: Reduces data privacy hurdles for enterprise adoption of frontier AI models.
